headline.before: I built the call funnel behind your

bridge.title: Four things I noticed

beats.title: A full webinar funnel. Then it stops.
beats.text: Your masterclass page on ClickFunnels collects names, emails and phone numbers, with SMS reminders for 15 October. 15,000 people follow you on Instagram and you've posted 393 YouTube videos since April 2025. After the masterclass, I couldn't find an application or a way to book a call.

beats.title: Savers who already trust you.
beats.text: You post every day for exactly one person: someone with money in savings who's afraid to invest it. Your “7 Paralysing Money Fears” guide speaks straight to them. Those are people who need a conversation before they commit.

beats.title: Everything rides on one evening.
beats.text: If someone can't make 8pm on 15 October, or they need to talk before deciding, there's no next step. Nervous savers rarely buy from a webinar alone, they want to ask their own question first.

beats.title: “The masterclass already does the selling.” Keep it.
beats.text: The masterclass stays the front door. The call funnel sits behind it, so attendees who aren't ready to buy on the night, and everyone who missed it, can apply and talk to you first.
beats.quote: “I help people who are new to investing that have money in savings but don't know how or where to start with investing.”

bridge.closing: So instead of explaining it, I built it. The page, the application, the emails and the ads, all below.

mechanism.body: You don't need to become an expert. You need someone to show you the order to do things in. In the coaching you go through the framework with Harriet in a small group, and leave with your own plan and your first investments made with confidence.

steps.title: Book a call
steps.body: If it looks like a fit, pick a time to talk with Harriet's team.

steps.title: Decide on the call
steps.body: We look at where you are and whether it makes sense. The investment is explained on the call. No pressure either way.

questions.q: Did you join the First Steps To Investing Masterclass?
What's stopped you from investing so far?
Can you give it about an hour a week for the next 8 weeks?
Do you understand that investing involves risk and you may get back less than you put in?
If you're accepted, are you ready to invest in coaching now?

notFit.title: Thank you for being honest.
notFit.body: Right now coaching isn't the right next step for you. Start with the free masterclass and the 7 Money Fears guide, and apply again when you're ready.

finalCta.title: Ready to make your savings work for you?
finalCta.body: Apply here. One application, one call, a straight answer.
finalCta.disclaimer: Educational content only. It does not take into account your individual circumstances and is not personal financial advice. Harriet is not authorised or regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority. Capital at risk: the value of investments can go down as well as up, and you may get back less than you invest.

preCallEmails.subject: You're booked: here's what happens next
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Your call is booked for {{call_time}}. The link is in your calendar invite.

Before we talk:
1. Keep the time free.
2. Have a rough idea of your savings and any accounts you already have.

One note: nobody on my team will ever ask you to pay through a DM. Payments only happen through the official links from this email address.

Talk soon,
Harriet

preCallEmails.subject: You just need the order
preCallEmails.previewText: Why a plan beats one more tip
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

You don't have to become an investing expert. Most savers just need someone to show them the order to do things in.

That's what the Freedom Finance Framework is, and what we'll talk about on the call.

On the call we'll look at where you are today.

Harriet

preCallEmails.subject: "I already watched the masterclass"
preCallEmails.previewText: Then this is the next step
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Great. Then you know the framework.

Coaching is for putting it into practice: a small group, live calls and your own plan, so you actually make your first investments.

If you're not sure you need it, ask on the call. We'll tell you honestly.

Harriet

preCallEmails.subject: What we'll cover on the call
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

The call takes about 30 minutes:

1. Where you are now and what you've tried.
2. Where you want to be in a year.
3. How the program works, what it costs, and whether it fits you.

If it isn't a fit, we'll tell you. No pressure either way.

Harriet

preCallEmails.subject: Tomorrow: your call with Harriet's team
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Quick reminder: your call is tomorrow at {{call_time}}.

If the time doesn't work anymore, reschedule with the link in your invite so someone else can take the slot.

See you tomorrow,
Harriet

preCallEmails.subject: Today's the day
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Your call is today at {{call_time}}. Find a quiet spot and have your questions ready.

Talk soon,
Harriet
